abandoned_car.title: Jackknifed Convoy Sedan
abandoned_car.text: A dust-choked sedan sits wedged against a jersey barrier. The trunk latch is sprung and the wiring harness hangs below the dash.

outcome.search: You pry open the trunk and rake through scattered emergency supplies.
outcome.strip_success: You cleanly sever the harness and pull intact electronics from the dash.
outcome.strip_failure: A rusted bracket snaps under tension and slices across your forearm.
outcome.leave: You bypass the wreck without breaking stride.

feral_dogs.title: Starved Pack on the Ridge
feral_dogs.text: Three rib-thin hounds fan out across the rubble ahead, hackles raised and jaws flecked with foam.

choice.stand: Hold ground and drive them off
choice.feed: Toss a ration to break their focus

outcome.stand_success: A decisive strike drops the lead hound; the pack scatters into the drainage ditch.
outcome.stand_failure: Teeth sink into your calf before you wrench free and club them back.
outcome.feed: The pack snaps over the thrown food while you slip two blocks downwind.
outcome.flee_success: You vault the rebar wall and lose them through a collapsed courtyard.
outcome.flee_failure: Loose brick gives way under your boot; the pack mauls your leg as you pull free.

raider_toll.title: Barricade Checkpoint
raider_toll.text: Armed scavengers step out from behind a burned bus, demanding rations for safe passage through the interchange.

choice.pay: Hand over two rations of food or water
choice.fight: Break through the barricade by force
choice.barter: Offer to repair their jammed generator

outcome.pay: They weigh your pouches, wave you through the wire, and watch until you clear the block.
outcome.fight_success: You drop the point man and strip his rig before the others retreat into the smoke.
outcome.fight_failure: Buckshot and shrapnel tear into your side as you fight your way clear.
outcome.barter_success: You clean the fouled injector; impressed, they toss you two oat bars and wave you on.
outcome.barter_failure: Your fix backfires in a shower of sparks. They beat you with rifle butts before shoving you out.

collapsed_overpass.title: Pancaked Highway Span
collapsed_overpass.text: Concrete slabs block the main corridor, leaving a treacherous tangle of rebar or a long detour around the basin.

choice.climb: Pick a route straight over the slabs

outcome.climb_success: You test each slab and crest the rubble without losing time.
outcome.climb_failure: A slab shifts underfoot, wrenching your ankle as you slide down the scree.
outcome.detour: You spend hours skirting flooded underpasses before rejoining the route.

acid_rain.title: Sulfa Squall on the Horizon
acid_rain.text: Yellow-gray clouds bruise the sky and the first oily drops hiss against rusted sheet metal.

choice.shelter: Wait out the squall under a concrete culvert
choice.push_on: Pull up your collar and march through it

outcome.shelter: You huddle beneath concrete until the caustic runoff subsides.
outcome.push_on_success: Your sealed poncho sheds the acidic downpour without a burn.
outcome.push_on_failure: Caustic rain soaks through your sleeves, blistering exposed skin.

supply_cache.title: Tripwire Civil-Defense Locker
supply_cache.text: Behind a false basement wall sits a stenciled relief crate — wired to a makeshift spring gun.

choice.open: Disarm the wire and crack the crate
choice.leave: Back away slowly and leave it

outcome.open_success: You crimp the tension wire and lift the lid on untouched emergency stock.
outcome.open_failure: The wire slips — a rusted bolt fires across your thigh before the latch gives.
outcome.leave: You mark the cellar on your mental map and leave the trap untouched.

rusted_debris.title: Shifting Steel Joists
rusted_debris.text: A promising storeroom lies pinned beneath a groaned web of corroded roof trusses.

choice.careful: Shore the beam andworm through carefully
choice.force: Wrench the sheet metal clear by brute force

outcome.careful_success: You slip beneath the truss and clear the passage without disturbing the load.
outcome.careful_failure: Jagged flashing drops from the ceiling, raking across your shoulder.
outcome.force: You tear free a slab of steel plate at the cost of scraped knuckles.

storm_at_sea.title: Cross-Swell Squall
storm_at_sea.text: Black swells hammer the hull and freezing spray floods the bilge halfway across the strait.

choice.ride_out: Lash the tiller and ride out the squall
choice.turn_back: Come about and run back for the departure port

outcome.ride_out_success: You keep the bow quartering the waves until the squall breaks.
outcome.ride_out_failure: A breaking crest slams the gunwale, washing gear overboard and bruising your ribs.
outcome.turn_back: You fight the rudder hard over and limp back to shore.

lone_survivor.title: Feverish Courier by the Tracks
lone_survivor.text: A gaunt courier sits propped against a signal box, clutching an empty canteen and a medic pouch.

choice.share: Spare a ration or bottle of water
choice.ignore: Give a wide berth and keep walking

outcome.share: Grateful, they press a handful of medical supplies into your palm before parting ways.
outcome.ignore: You keep your hand on your weapon and pass without a word.

night_prowler.title: Footsteps Outside the Bivouac
night_prowler.text: Gravel crunches in the dark just beyond your shelter doorway; someone is testing the latch.

choice.confront: Lunging into the doorway with weapon raised
choice.hide: Kill your light and slip into the crawlspace

outcome.confront_success: You catch the intruder off-balance and drive them scrambling into the alley.
outcome.confront_failure: A blade flashes in the dark, catching your ribs before the prowler bolts.
outcome.hide_success: The prowler sweeps the empty room and moves on empty-handed.
outcome.hide_failure: You stay hidden, but they snatch a pouch from the floor on their way out.

radio_static.title: Shortwave Carrier Burst
radio_static.text: A solarrepeater atop a utility pole clicks to life, broadcasting automated weather beacons from distant sectors.

choice.listen: Log the coordinates from the carrier loop (30m)
choice.ignore: Save the daylight and move on

outcome.listen: You copy down grid bearings for distant transit hubs before the carrier fades.
outcome.ignore: You leave the repeater clicking into the wind.

decompression_chamber.title: Collapsed Highway Field Clinic
decompression_chamber.text: A wounded soldier is pinned beneath an oxygen manifold with acute tension pneumothorax. His trachea is pushed left and his breath rattles violently. Beside him rests a sealed military rucksack.

choice.loot_pack: Strip the rucksack and retreat into the rubble
choice.leave: Leave him to the failing monitors

outcome.decompress_success: A hiss of pressurized air and dark blood erupts. The soldier decompresses and coughs, handing you his morphine reserve in gratitude.
outcome.decompress_failure: The needle slips against fractured rib cartilage, tearing into soft tissue before you pull away.
outcome.loot_pack: You slice through the nylon straps and take emergency rations while his boots drum against the floor.
outcome.leave: You step backward into the dust and let the silence take the ward.

checkpoint_siphon.title: Viaduct Toll Post (Iron Rail Company)
checkpoint_siphon.text: Deserters in heavy coats have barricaded the bridge with railroad ties and a sandbagged machine gun. Their leader demands caloric tribute or ammunition.

choice.pay_toll: Pay the 2x ration toll for unhindered passage
choice.fight_sentry: Draw your weapon and break the roadblock by force
choice.scale_gorge: Descend into the freezing gorge and scale the abutment

outcome.pay_toll: The sentry weighs your rations and waves you through: 'Keep your head down in the tunnel, traveler.'
outcome.fight_sentry_success: Accurate defensive fire shatters their sandbag position, forcing the surviving pickets to retreat down the embankment.
outcome.fight_sentry_failure: Heavy automatic fire pins you behind concrete; shrapnel tears into your thigh before you stumble clear.
outcome.scale_gorge_success: You drag yourself through waist-deep industrial runoff and scale the cliff, bypassing the toll unseen.
outcome.scale_gorge_failure: The freezing sludge numbs your hands. You slip on wet gravel, wrenching your knee against concrete.

protocol47_cache.title: Hardened Civil Defense Terminal
protocol47_cache.text: An analog terminal glows amber inside a blast-proof alcove. A blinking prompt displays classified military dispatch logs titled 'PROTOCOL 47'.

choice.decrypt: Bypass logic interlock and copy dispatch logs
choice.salvage: Strip copper coils and battery cells from the terminal
choice.ignore: Leave the terminal humming in the dark

outcome.decrypt_success: The magnetic core dumps encrypted dispatch records revealing the true origin of the Black Sea EMP.
outcome.decrypt_failure: A power surge sparks across the circuit board, scorching your fingers and fusing the logic chips.
outcome.salvage: You harvest insulated copper wiring and intact scrap metal from the auxiliary casing.
outcome.ignore: You leave the CRT phosphor fading into the vault shadows.

nomad_guild.title: Nomad Guild Trade Caravans
nomad_guild.desc: An expansive confederation of merchant clans and scavengers who traverse ancient Silk Road corridors with water purification convoys and camel/draft caravans.

ash_marauders.title: Ash Marauder Doctrine
ash_marauders.desc: Desperate raiders and scavenger renegades who claim viaduct checkpoints and choke points, extorting passing travelers with toll barriers and ambush raiding.

trauma_tccc.desc: Post-collapse medical doctrine prioritizing rapid bleeding control with CAT Tourniquets, needle decompression for tension pneumothorax, and fracture stabilization using SAM splints.

weather_extremes.title: Atmospheric Toxicity Profiles
weather_extremes.desc: Industrial ruins emit corrosive acid rain capable of melting skin and synthetic gear, while radioactive ash fronts require sealed NBC respirators and enclosed cabin shelters.

vehicle_overland.title: Expedition Motorization Protocol
vehicle_overland.desc: Motorized overland transit provides 3x-4.5x speed advantages and immense trunk cargo capacity, but combustion engine noise heavily attracts marauders and roving beasts.

airdrop.title: EMERGENCY SUPPLY AIRDROP
airdrop.desc: A supply drone drops a sealed canister at {location}, packed with emergency rations, potable water, and medical bandages.

log.reward_granted: Emergency airdrop canister deployed! Supplies have landed at your coordinates.
log.reward_granted_vip: 👑 VIP ACCESS: Emergency airdrop delivered instantly without commercial delay!
log.dismissed: Emergency broadcast interrupted. Supply drop aborted.

ui.tuning_hint: Rotate the analog dial or use AUTO-SCAN to sweep the wasteland frequencies (88.0 - 108.0 MHz).

BROADCAST EMERGENCY SOS PING?

Consumes 40m battery. May summon friendly nomad aid or attract hostile raiders!
ui.beacon_here_hint: An intercepted transmission pinpointed coordinates in this sector.

dr_aris.name: Mayday // Emergency Clinic SOS
dr_aris.transcript: Mayday, this is Dr. Aris from the Sector Medical Annex... Our barricades will not hold the swarm much longer. If anyone receives this, coordinates are locked to the clinic basement cache. Take whatever medical supplies you can carry...

numbers_station.name: Station Echo-309 // NATO Numbers Station
numbers_station.transcript: [STATIC BEEP] ... 7 - 4 - 1 - 9 - 2 ... [CHIRP] ... SECTOR SOFIA EMERGENCY BUNKER ACCESS CODE CONFIRMED ... [CYCLE REPEAT] ...

raider_ambush.name: Intercept // Jackal Raider Band
raider_ambush.transcript: All units hold perimeter at the Ankara canyon pass. Road spikes and fuel traps are armed. Scavenger spotted inbound... kill on sight...

weather_beacon.name: NOAA Emergency Meteorological Beacon
weather_beacon.transcript: ATTENTION SURVIVORS: Atmospheric ion disturbance and acid precipitation front tracking over sector. Seek hardened indoor shelter immediately...

nomad_caravan.name: Nomad Merchant Caravan Broadcast
nomad_caravan.transcript: Peace to the wasteland. The Red Star Caravan has made camp in Sector Bucharest for the next 24 hours. We carry clean water, scrap, and rare filters. Come unarmed or face our guards.

pulsar_anomaly.name: Unknown Frequency // Pulsar Pulse
pulsar_anomaly.transcript: [RHYTHMIC METALLIC CHANTS] ... The sky fractured, but the core endures... 106.3 MHz resonates with the old reactor beneath Kyiv... Do not let the radiation blind you...
